The actual historical no-join01 pair verified RC2 backup, real update to retained1ac, exact installed identities/scripts, and unchanged original pointers/cloud bytes. It then failed with usage rc2 because the old scanner supports its no-argument full scan, not the later --folder option. Allfour1/21seals and actual pair/backend cleanup are retained23:12:05/10. This usage error is not the required negative control.

Source review also shows the historical fresh default reports STATE=current/SOURCE=- without examining earlier roots. The corrected fixture must require that shipped behavior, and separately prove that the original save is reachable through the same real client before checking no-join/no-restore. It must not impose current scanner semantics on old software.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes: actual retained RC2 and1ac images, updated-a/fresh-b, one owned local WebDAV. Historical /Rasteratops is only a negative-control default; no current fielded migration gate is added.

Acceptance criteria:
- [x] Retain failed01 source/usage/readbacks and all result/seal/cleanup evidence; bind the supported no-argument interface and state expectations to actual historical source.
- [x] Fresh pair verifies exact historical image/scripts and in-place update, preserves original bytes/pointers, and reaches the original save through the actual old client before the supported full scan.
- [x] Actual old full scan reports its current-default blindspot, seeding does not join earlier pointers, and default restore cannot retrieve the earlier witness. Original cloud bytes remain intact; record expected failures separately from tool errors, with all completion/seal/cleanup evidence.

Already written: historical behavior is intentionally unchanged. Only the test invokes the supported old interface and separately proves provider reachability. Refs #354, #471.
